scenario.name: RSS Feed to Dropbox Archive
scenario.description: Fetches an RSS feed hourly, deduplicates articles, and saves each new item as a plain-text file in a Dropbox folder. Useful for building a personal read-later archive. Requires one credential: dropbox_token.

agents.name: Fetch RSS Feed
agents.description: Polls an RSS or Atom feed once per hour. Change feed_url to any feed you want to archive.

agents.name: Deduplicate Articles
agents.description: Drops articles already seen in the past 30 days so each item is only saved once even if the feed re-publishes it.

agents.name: Format Article
agents.description: Renders a plain-text article file and a safe filename slug from the RSS item fields.

templates.file_slug: {{ published[:10] }}_{{ title[:60] | lower | replace(' ', '-') | replace('/', '-') | replace(':', '') | replace('?', '') | replace('!', '') | replace(',', '') | replace('"', '') | replace("'", '') | replace('.', '') | truncate(60, False, '') }}

agents.name: Save to Dropbox
agents.description: Writes each article as a .txt file in /rss-archive/. The filename is a date-prefixed slug derived from the article title. Add your Dropbox access token as a credential named dropbox_token before enabling.
